commands.review_summary:
The PR adds an optional `agents.*.sandbox.skipSkillsSync` flag, propagates it through sandbox setup and prompt routing, skips skill-copy work when enabled, and adds focused unit tests.

PR surface: Source +41, Tests +127. Total +168 across 10 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-level only: with `skipSkillsSync` propagated into the command/system-prompt path but no `skillsSnapshot` supplied, the helper drops snapshot prompt text and then loads workspace-only entries from the skipped materialization directory. I did not run a live sandbox scenario in this read-only review.

target.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Skills are copied into the sandbox workspace on every sandbox setup. For users who do not use skills or have already deployed them through other means, this sync is unnecessary overhead that slows down sandbox initialization and consumes disk space.

Related: #97638

## Why This Change Was Made

The issue requests a config toggle to skip the skills sync step. This change adds skipSkillsSync as an optional boolean under agents.defaults.sandbox and agents.list[].sandbox, defaulting to false (preserving existing behavior).

## User Impact

Users can now opt out of skill sync with:

```json5
{
  agents: {
    defaults: {
      sandbox: {
        skipSkillsSync: true,
      },
    },
  },
}
```

Safe-use caveat: This flag is intended for advanced deployments where skills are preinstalled in the sandbox workspace through other means (custom Docker image, setupCommand, readonly workspace mounts). When enabled, file copying is skipped but the skills snapshot is preserved, so Agent prompts continue to advertise available skills from the session-start snapshot. Env overrides from skills are also preserved.

## Evidence

### Architecture

The fix addresses the root cause identified by ClawSweeper review: `resolveSandboxSkillRuntimeInputs` unconditionally set `skillsSnapshot: undefined` for sandboxed runs. When `skipSkillsSync=true`, file copying is skipped AND the snapshot was dropped, meaning:
1. Skills workspace empty (files not copied) — correct
2. Snapshot discarded (prompt text lost) — BUG

Fix: When `skipSkillsSync=true`, preserve the skills snapshot so prompt text and env overrides remain available. The snapshot's pre-rendered prompt is self-contained and does not require filesystem access.

### Data flow

```
skipSkillsSync=true in config
  → SandboxConfig.skipSkillsSync (config.ts)
  → SandboxContext.skipSkillsSync (context.ts)
  → SandboxWorkspaceInfo.skipSkillsSync (ensureSandboxWorkspaceForSession)
  → SandboxSkillRuntimeContext.skipSkillsSync (all 4 callers)
  → resolveSandboxSkillRuntimeInputs conditionally preserves skillsSnapshot
  → resolveSkillsPromptForRun uses snapshotPrompt instead of live entries
  → applySkillEnvOverridesFromSnapshot for env vars (equivalent to live path)
```

### Test evidence

All 40 tests pass (4 test files, 0 failures).

| Test | File | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| preserves the skills snapshot when skipSkillsSync is enabled | sandbox-skills.test.ts | returns undefined | returns the snapshot |
| drops the skills snapshot when skipSkillsSync is absent | sandbox-skills.test.ts | returns undefined | returns undefined (unchanged) |
| returns skipSkillsSync from ensureSandboxWorkspaceForSession | resolveSandboxContext.test.ts | N/A | returns skipSkillsSync: true |
| skips skill sync when enabled (ro) | resolveSandboxContext.test.ts | N/A | syncSkillsToWorkspace not called, skillsEligibility returned |
| skips skill sync when enabled (rw) | resolveSandboxContext.test.ts | N/A | syncSkillsToWorkspace not called, skillsEligibility returned |
| requests skill sync (existing, unchanged) | resolveSandboxContext.test.ts | sync is called | sync is called (unchanged) |

### Changed files

12 files, +117/-26 total:
src/config/types.agents-shared.ts (+1)
src/config/zod-schema.agent-runtime.ts (+1)
src/agents/sandbox/types.ts (+2) SandboxConfig + SandboxWorkspaceInfo + SandboxContext
src/agents/sandbox/config.ts (+1)
src/agents/sandbox/context.ts (+15/-24) computeSandboxSkillsEligibility + skipSkillsSync propagation
src/agents/sandbox.resolveSandboxContext.test.ts (+84) tests for both eligibility and snapshot
src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/sandbox-skills.ts (+10/-2) SandboxSkillRuntimeContext + conditional snapshot
src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/sandbox-skills.test.ts (+41) 2 new unit tests
src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts (+3) pass skipSkillsSync
src/auto-reply/reply/commands-system-prompt.ts (+3) pass skipSkillsSync

Human-driven development with AI assistant support. Changes implemented using TDD: all tests were written before production code.
